MSGID_UPDATEAVAILABLE.content: A new version of Breeze Core is available. Download and install it now? The server is stopped for the upgrade and started again afterwards; its settings and paired units are kept.

MSGID_GOTODOWNLOADPAGETEXT.content: Breeze Core is up to date. See $MSGID_MOREINFO$, or the $MSGID_DOWNLOADPAGE$ for every other platform.

MSGID_DOWNLOADSTOPPED.content: The download was stopped, so nothing was updated.

MSGID_CLOSEAPP.content: is running. The updater will close it to install the update. Continue?

MSGID_NODOWNLOADFOLDER.content: There is nowhere to download the update to: none of %TEMP%, %TMP% or %APPDATA% is set.
